# Template: assumption and evidence register

Use one row per input, model setting, or reported output that could affect a decision. This Markdown version is easy to copy into a project record; a blank [CSV version](assumption-evidence-register.csv) is available for a spreadsheet workflow.

| ID | Quantity/location | Value and unit | Evidence status | Source, version, and date | Boundary / applicability | Uncertainty or limitation | Next action |

## Minimum use rules

- Record property-evaluation temperature, pressure, and composition with every fluid property.
- Distinguish a measured sensor output from a derived model input.
- Record a simulation geometry/configuration and boundary condition with every simulated output.
- Do not convert an unknown into an assumed value without labeling it and explaining its decision sensitivity.
- Revise the row when a source, configuration, or model version changes.
